items.summary: "The whole thing is fictitious, what are you talking about?"
items.body: An undersea power cable linking the UK National Grid to Ireland has been forced to relocate, after Harry Potter fans complained it would go through Dobby's grave. You know, Dobby the house elf . The fictional character created by J.K. Rowling. Fans became aware of the desecration of Dobby's memorial after a BBC interview with project manager Simon Ludlam, who detailed plans to put the cable underground at Freshwater West beach in Wales (via The Guardian ). This just happens to be the location where Dobby's fictional death was shot for Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 1 , and the site of a fan-made shrine. According to Ludlam: "We did the [BBC] shot, we finished, I went back to London, and they then aired it a couple of weeks later. And we got hundreds of calls, I mean, hundreds of calls." Ludlam doesn't appear to be a Harry Potter fan, as he expressed confusion over all the fuss created by the location. A colleague told him "Apparently, we're going to go straight through Dobby's grave." "Dobby, who's Dobby?" Ludlam recounts. items.summary: مفاوضات جادة وعرض مبدئي
items.body: مفاوضات جادة وعرض مبدئي بدأ برشلونة تحركاته تحسبًا لإعادة تشكيل خطه الخلفي، إذ فتح النادي الكتالوني قنوات اتصال مع أحد أبرز الخيارات في الدوري الإنجليزي الممتاز، استعدادًا لرحيل محتمل لجول كوندي. ونقل موقع مترو عن تقارير إسبانية، أن برشلونة تواصل مع محيط بيدرو بورو، ظهير توتنهام، لاستطلاع إمكانية ضمه خلال فترة الانتقالات الصيفية، في ظل اهتمام آرسنال بالتعاقد مع كوندي. وقال الصحفي جيرارد روميرو عبر قناته على يوتيوب أن برشلونة بدأ اتصالاته بقوة مع محيط بورو خلال الأيام الأخيرة، حيث قدم عرضا مبدئيا لوكلائه. ورغم ذلك، لم يُظهر كوندي حتى الآن رغبة في مغادرة برشلونة، بينما لا يزال مستقبله مفتوحًا، ما دفع النادي إلى التحرك مبكرًا تحسبًا لأي تطورات. ويبلغ بورو 26 عامًا، وقدم مستويات مميزة مع توتنهام، كما شارك أساسيًا في معظم مباريات منتخب إسبانيا خلال مشواره نحو التتويج بكأس العالم الأخيرة. ويرتبط الظهير الإسباني بعقد مع توتنهام حتى عام 2031، بعدما جدد عقده في يونيو الماضي، كما يحظى بثقة المدرب روبرتو دي زيربي، الذي وصفه بأنه لاعب مهم وقادر على التأثير في المباريات دفاعيًا وهجوميًا. ويأتي اهتمام برشلونة ببورو بسبب قدرته على شغل أكثر من دور في الخط الخلفي، وهو ما يتناسب مع احتياجات الفريق في حال رحيل كوندي. اقرأ أيضا: تعقيدات في ميركاتو آرسنال.. هل ينقذه نجم برشلونة؟

items.summary: ماذا تقول لوائح اليويفا؟
items.body: ماذا تقول لوائح اليويفا؟ يستعد ملعب ريد بول أرينا في مدينة سالزبورج النمساوية، لاستضافة مباراة السوبر الأوروبي، اليوم الأربعاء، بين باريس سان جيرمان وأستون فيلا، في افتتاحية الموسم الجديد. وتوّج باريس سان جيرمان بلقب دوري أبطال أوروبا للعام الثاني على التوالي ، بعد تغلبه على آرسنال بركلات الترجيح، بينما على الجانب الآخر، حقق أستون فيلا لقب الدوري الأوروبي باكتساح فرايبورج (3-0). وتساءل كثيرون كيف يُحسم السوبر الأوروبي في حالة التعادل؟، هل يلعب الفريقان شوطين إضافيين أم يذهبان مباشرة لركلات الترجيح؟ تنص لوائح الاتحاد الأوروبي لكرة القدم "يويفا" على أنه إذا انتهت مباراة السوبر الأوروبي بالتعادل بعد 90 دقيقة، لن يلعب الفريقان وقتًا إضافيًا، وسينتقلان مباشرةً إلى ركلات الترجيح. طُبقت هذه القاعدة في النسخة الماضية، التي فاز بها باريس سان جيرمان على توتنهام بركلات الترجيح، بعدما عاد الفريق الفرنسي في الدقائق الأخيرة، ونجح في انتزاع التعادل بعد التأخر (2-0). وتبقى لوائح الاتحاد الأوروبي لكرة القدم دون تغيير هذا العام، وبالتالي سيُحسم الفائز مباشرةً من ركلات الترجيح إذا استمر التعادل في سالزبورج.

You can refer to my Mistria marriage candidates list for a little hint on what each of their personal storylines are like. Two other singles are revealed later in the story that you'll often see other players refer to as the "secret bachelor/ette." Give gifts Like other farm sims, you can give items to characters to earn Friendship Points . You can give one gift to each character every day. Use my Mistria gift guide to earn points with each marriage candidate fastest. Don't neglect quests You'll need to keep up with the main story to get the most out of romance. items.title: MMO heads rejoice, Razer is bringing out the Naga V3 Pro with upgraded switches, loads of customizability and a ridiculous DPI
items.summary: It's like the V2 Pro, but a little lighter and a bit better.
items.body: MMO gaming mice look a bit funky. You probably knew that already. With sometimes dozens of buttons for all the different controls, they're niche by nature. Yet the newly unveiled Razer Naga V3 Pro looks to get around that, claiming to be both easy to use and button-heavy at the same time. In a sense, it seems like a pretty safe upgrade from the Naga V2 Pro from back in 2022. Like that model, it ships with three swappable plates by your thumb. The standard layout has a dozen buttons, but you can replace them with a mere six (or just two) for ease of use. With two further buttons besides the left click, and two more under the scroll wheel, the Naga V3 Pro can have 23, 17 or 13 buttons total. Razer says these plates snap into place in seconds without any tools. The idea being you can flip between them when you load up different games. It envisions players using the dozen buttons for MMOs, six buttons for MOBA and battle royales, then the two buttons for FPS games or everyday use. And he's pretty sure the genre is a bad fit for the AAA arms race. "Myself and other folks who have worked extensively on immersive sims have a belief that the immersive sims that are being created today and are slated for the future are, by and large, thinking of themselves as [existing] in an arms race to be bigger and better," he tells us. And this has been happening for a while. Just think about how Deus Ex: Mankind Divided pushed things in terms of fidelity. Or how big and expensive Arkane's modern offerings have been. items.body: Would you believe me if I told you the Pulsar Feinmann F01 Noctua Edition is actually the second gaming mouse with a fan I've tried? Back in 2021, I had the unique experience of getting my clammy mitts on the Marsback Zephyr Pro, and I was… a fan. But I can comfortably say that Pulsar's Feinmann F01 Noctua Edition is the most luxurious gaming mouse with a fan I've tried—a prestigious award, I know. It's loaded with great specs, like a Pulsar XS-2 sensor with up to 42,000 DPI and up to an 8,000 Hz polling rate. As such, it's not just a gaming mouse with a fan; it's a full-on competitive device. I suspect the most 'love it or hate it' aspect of Pulsar and Noctua's Frankenstein gaming mouse won't actually have anything to do with the aforementioned fan but will instead be its honeycomb shell. In order for the fan to actually blow cold air on your palm, it needs room to do so, and the spaces in the shell are plenty. They also come with the added benefit of taking some weight off, which is needed because the F01 Noctua Edition is pretty heavy at 73 g. items.title: Firefox stunts on Edge as Microsoft gears up to neuter adblockers: 'uBlock Origin isn't going anywhere'
items.summary: Blocked. Blocked. Blocked. None of these corpo browsers are free of sin.
items.body: Earlier this year, Google Chrome annoyed a whole lot of adblock users by killing support for Manifest V2 extensions . It's a Manifest V3 world now, which means the permissions and APIs that thoroughgoing adblockers like uBlock Origin rely on are a thing of the past on Chrome (it's since been replaced by a pared-down version: uBlock Origin Lite ). Now, Microsoft Edge is following suit: "Over the next few months, MV2 extensions will be gradually turned off by default," says Redmond . All of which is red meat for the folks over at Mozilla Firefox, the free-and-open-source browser that once reigned supreme on our PCs before Chrome came and ate its lunch. items.body: No Man's Sky has changed an awful lot in the 10 years since its launch. Hello Games' space sandbox has received a few dozen major free updates that have added features like base-building, spaceship construction, multiplayer missions, companions, mechs, and even its own version of the Death Star . Speaking to PC Gamer for No Man's Sky's 10th anniversary, Sean Murray said that despite all those massive changes and added features that have transformed the space sandbox… he still likes the 2016 version of No Man's Sky just fine. "I've gone back to the original, played the game without any updates," Murray said. "And I've got a real soft spot for it, to be honest. It's a more esoteric experience. It's a little bit weirder, but it's got its charm." "The feeling that I have when I play it is, I'm alone and I'm on a planet and I don't know what's over the hill," Murray said. "And I really love that feeling." Which isn't to say the updated No Man's Sky, even with its busy community events and multiplayer hubs, can't feel that way too.
